package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"time"
)

type OnboardingPathExecutionRepository interface {
	NextAcceptedHandoff(context.Context) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, error)
	NextOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingPathExecution, error)
	CreateOrGetOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution) (domain.OnboardingPathExecution, bool, error)
	ClaimOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingPathExecution, error)
	RenewOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, string, string, int64, time.Time, time.Time, time.Time) error
	CheckpointOnboardingSnapshot(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, []byte, string, string, int64, time.Time, time.Time) error
	CheckpointOnboardingCourse(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, []byte, string, time.Time) error
	CheckpointOnboardingCourseReceipt(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, string, bool, []domain.CourseLessonBinding, time.Time) error
	CheckpointOnboardingMaterialization(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, string, time.Time) error
	ListOnboardingPathLessonContent(context.Context, string) ([]domain.OnboardingPathLessonContent, error)
	CheckpointOnboardingPathLessonContent(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, domain.OnboardingPathLessonContent) error
	CompleteOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, time.Time) error
	RetryOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error
}
